_comment: A-W1 spec, Tests. The three decision bodies the iPhone sends to PATCH /api/app/v1/admin/proposals/{id}. The iOS XCTest encodes ProposalDecisionBody for each case and asserts this exact JSON; the vitest test feeds each body to parseProposalTransitionRequest and asserts the action and note it reads. A misspelled or dropped adminNotes would still parse (as an empty note), and «Pedir cambios» would commit with no note in the thread.

body.adminNotes: Cambia la segunda canción a G

parsed.adminNotes: Cambia la segunda canción a G
